messages.subject: Re: Spatial Shrunken Centroids - White pixels
messages.body_plain:
Hi Lennart,

Typically this would mean those pixels are missing. But typically white is not a default color used for segmentations either, so depending on what color function you used, they may actually be another cluster.

-Kylie

messages.subject: Comparing MSImage with .tiff image
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kylie,

I have been working long time with Cardinal, getting a lot of help from it.
Now I have preprocessed my images and also classified, I would like to compare my image with a .tiff image. However, the size does not match completely since .tiff image is just an optical image of the sample, so I cannot do the correlation of images directly. So, is there any helpful tool from Cardinal to change the dimensions of the image, or comparing images of different dimension? If not, do you know of any way to face this problem?

Thanks,

Suhyung

messages.subject_clean: How to select regions of Interest in Cardinal

Thank you very much for your help.

Does anyone know how to select Regions of Interest (ROIs) in Cardinal or Could Cardinal read the ROI.xml file created in Bruker flexImaging?

Yours Chao

messages.subject_clean: How to select regions of Interest in Cardinal
messages.body_plain:
https://github.com/NHPatterson/Cardinal_functions/blob/master/Import_FlexImaging_XMLs.R

I wrote a function to do that a long time ago when I was more novice in R. I can't say how good the code is anymore since it is not extensively tested but it worked for me at the time. Essentially it reads in the 'RrrrXxxxYyyy' data in the Bruker flexImaging XML and compares it against the cardinal coordinates.

Heath
